name: No raw i18n keys or untranslated placeholders leak into the rendered page
description: When a translation lookup is missing, frameworks often print the raw key (match.detail.title), an unsubstituted interpolation token ({{team}}), or a sentinel like MISSING_TRANSLATION. None of these may be visible on a localized page. This is a direct signal that a stub i18n layer fails.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /es/match/<captured-id> and scan all visible UI text (nav, tabs, labels, headings, status pills)

Verify no visible text is a raw i18n key (dot-delimited token like match.detail.title), an unresolved interpolation placeholder (text containing {{ }} or %s), or a MISSING_TRANSLATION / undefined sentinel. Any such leaked token fails the test.
